entries.definition: a piece of equipment made for a purpose
entries.example: This small device measures the temperature in our kitchen.

entries.definition: programs that tell a computer what to do
entries.example: The library uses free software to manage its books.

entries.definition: a computer program for a particular task
entries.example: The application stores my notes without an internet connection.

entries.definition: a program used to open websites
entries.example: Open a new browser tab to check the address.

entries.definition: a secret combination used to enter an account
entries.example: Choose a password that you do not use elsewhere.

entries.definition: a personal record that gives access to a service
entries.example: I created an account to borrow digital books.

entries.definition: to copy data from an online service to your device
entries.example: You can download the map before your trip.

entries.definition: to send data from your device to an online service
entries.example: Please upload the photograph after checking its size.

entries.definition: to put a program on a device so it can run
entries.example: I will install the reading app this evening.

entries.definition: a newer version that changes or improves something
entries.example: The latest update fixes a problem with saved notes.

entries.definition: a named collection of data stored on a computer
entries.example: Keep the original file before changing its contents.

entries.definition: a place used to organize computer files
entries.example: I put each month’s receipts in a separate folder.

entries.definition: a written record stored on paper or a computer
entries.example: Please read the document before adding your name.

entries.definition: the set of keys used to enter text
entries.example: This keyboard has both English and Persian letters.

entries.definition: the surface on which a device shows information
entries.example: The screen is easier to read at this brightness.

entries.definition: a small control that starts an action
entries.example: Press the green button to save your work.

entries.definition: to select something using a mouse or similar control
entries.example: Please click the title to open the article.

entries.definition: a connection that takes you to another digital location
entries.example: The email contains a link to the meeting notes.

entries.definition: a collection of related pages on the internet
entries.example: The museum’s website lists its current opening hours.

entries.definition: to look carefully for information or something missing
entries.example: You can search the library by title or topic.

entries.definition: connected to or available through the internet
entries.example: The online lesson starts at seven this evening.

entries.definition: working without an internet connection
entries.example: The offline map helped us find the village.

entries.definition: a link that allows devices to communicate
entries.example: A weak connection interrupted the video call.

entries.definition: a group of connected computers or devices
entries.example: Our office network connects the printer to every computer.

entries.definition: an electronic message that carries information
entries.example: The phone signal is weak inside the basement.

entries.definition: space used to keep digital information
entries.example: Large videos use much more storage than text notes.

entries.definition: an extra copy kept in case the original is lost
entries.example: I keep a backup of my writing on another drive.

entries.definition: to bring saved data back into use
entries.example: We can restore the notes from yesterday’s backup.

entries.definition: to remove digital information
entries.example: Check the folder before you delete any files.

entries.definition: to store digital work for later use
entries.example: Remember to save your draft before closing the window.

entries.definition: to let other people receive or use something
entries.example: May I share these notes with the study group?

entries.definition: to add a file to a message
entries.example: Please attach the receipt to your email.

entries.definition: the way digital information is arranged or stored
entries.example: The teacher requested the article in a text format.

entries.definition: controls that change how a device or program works
entries.example: You can change the text size in settings.

entries.definition: a short message that tells you something new
entries.example: A notification reminded me about the evening lesson.

entries.definition: control over access to personal information or activities
entries.example: The app explains how it protects your privacy.

entries.definition: protection against unwanted access or damage
entries.example: Regular updates can improve the security of a device.

entries.definition: the ability or permission to use something
entries.example: Students have access to the reading room after class.

entries.definition: a particular function or useful part of a product
entries.example: The bookmark feature helps me return to long articles.

entries.definition: using electronic data rather than physical forms
entries.example: A digital copy is useful when I travel.

entries.definition: working without a person starting every action
entries.example: Automatic saving protects my draft while I write.

entries.definition: controlled or done directly by a person
entries.example: The camera also offers manual control of focus.

entries.definition: able to be trusted to work well
entries.example: We need a reliable way to store important records.

entries.definition: a container that supplies electrical power
entries.example: My phone’s battery lasted through the long journey.

entries.definition: a device that puts power into a battery
entries.example: I left my charger beside the hotel bed.

entries.definition: a covered wire used to carry power or information
entries.example: The short cable connects the laptop to the screen.

entries.definition: a machine that produces paper copies of digital text
entries.example: The printer stopped because it had no paper.

entries.definition: to make a digital image of a paper document
entries.example: We will scan the signed form for our records.

entries.definition: to store sound, images, or information for later use
entries.example: You can record a short speaking practice on your phone.

entries.definition: to follow and keep information about change over time
entries.example: A simple chart can track your study habits.
